title: Review Attention Map: follow the reason
audience: Reviewers who need concrete contract and behavior signals on a diff without a hidden risk score.
promise: Overlay explicit signals, navigate to their originating evidence, and keep stale, unmatched, and human-reviewed state visible.
story: A changed API line receives one Contract Watch signal and one Behavior Coverage Atlas signal.
The map groups both signals into one region while preserving each source reference.
A stale signal outside the diff remains unmatched instead of disappearing.
The reviewer records a disposition without turning the surface into a merge verdict.
verified_locally: Two-source overlay groups contract and behavior signals on one changed line.
Direct review command records a human disposition on the region.
An outside-diff signal remains explicitly unmatched with limitations visible.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass.
open_gates: Exercise the same handoff on current producer receipts with source/freshness readback.
Expand stale, unmatched, and reviewed negative scenarios on the current surface.
Capture a crop-safe image preview and verify a hosted no-auth case.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a local W3 two-source overlay and review-disposition slice; it does not claim complete producer integration, runtime coverage, hosting, or publication.
